page.notes: The last line is a catchword split across the line end ("Nico-" / "las"); kept as the catchword. The "sçavoir" is written "çavoir" in print, with the long s dropped. Roman numerals are printed with spaces (I V, I I I) and are written joined here. "Eftienne" has an ink blot above the letter, which I read as a stain. Stray dots at the left edge of the text block (before "tinople", "Nicolas", "Formose") are show-through or specks, not notes. The "2" at the bottom left is faint and may be a signature mark or a speck. The line "cession ... mediatement. ;" is a continuation from the previous page; the stray ";" after the full stop is kept as printed.
